green.$description: Spotify green: selected chips, the play button, the saved tick, pins, the tab underline and the slider's filled part all read this value.
The iOS system green (dark appearance), used only by switches. It is not Spotify green: the app keeps the stock UISwitch.

music.$description: Search > Browse all tile 'Music'. Each category has its own flat colour with tilted artwork in the corner.

podcasts.$description: Search > Browse all tile 'Podcasts'. Each category has its own flat colour with tilted artwork in the corner.

liveEvents.$description: Search > Browse all tile 'Live Events'. Each category has its own flat colour with tilted artwork in the corner.

fitness.$description: Search > Browse all tile 'Fitness'. Each category has its own flat colour with tilted artwork in the corner.

madeForYou.$description: Search > Browse all tile 'Made For You'. Each category has its own flat colour with tilted artwork in the corner.

upcoming.$description: Search > Browse all tile 'Upcoming releases'. Each category has its own flat colour with tilted artwork in the corner. The same value as 'Podcasts'.

newReleases.$description: Search > Browse all tile 'New Releases'. Each category has its own flat colour with tilted artwork in the corner.

playlisting.$description: Search > Browse all tile 'The Art of Playlisting'. Each category has its own flat colour with tilted artwork in the corner.

sm.$description: Home shortcut tiles (3.4pt) and browse category tiles (3.4pt). Plus or minus 2 pt.

md.$description: Cards and panels: the promo card (8.5pt), the mini player (8.5pt), settings quick tiles (8.5pt), the drawer's account card (8.5pt) and notification card (8.5pt). Plus or minus 2 pt.

field.$description: The resting search field: 6.8pt, plus or minus 2 pt; its corners look tighter than the cards'.

sheet.$description: Top corners of the context, sort and share sheets (iOS 26 glass): 34.1pt.

capsule.$description: Fully round ends: chips, the Pre-save, Following and Turn on pills, the focused search field, Cancel, the segmented control, switches. Circles (play button, avatars, share targets, the saved tick) use it too.

base.$description: Measured gaps land on multiples of 4 pt within a pixel or two.

xs.$description: Between a row title and its subtitle, and around small icons in a subtitle (pin, download).

sm.$description: Between home shortcut tiles (7.5 pt), between chips (8.5 pt), and the inset of the mini player and sheets from the screen edge (8 pt).

md.$description: Artwork to text in a list row (12.5 pt in 10-library and 09-search-results-rows); settings quick tiles start 12 pt from the edge.

lg.$description: Screen margin (tiles, cards, rows and headings start 16 pt from the edge) and the gap between browse tiles (16.5 pt).

xl.$description: Below a home section title before its row of cards (about 22 pt in 02-home).

screenMargin.$description: Left and right margin of tiles, cards, rows and headings.

chip.$description: Filter chips: 79x31pt selected (green, a crisp edge), 33pt tall unselected with the glass rim.

pill.$description: Small pill buttons: Pre-save 104.5x31pt, Turn on 95.5x31pt, Following 92pt x 29pt (outlined).

shortcutTile.$description: Home shortcut tile height; the artwork is a square of the same size at its left. Two tiles share a row (175pt wide each).

categoryTile.$description: Browse category tile height; two per row (170x104pt).

promoCard.$description: Promo card (Upcoming release) height, full width (358.5pt).

searchField.$description: Resting search field (white): 357x47pt inside its anti-aliased edge.

searchFieldFocused.$description: Focused search field (glass capsule), rim included; Cancel beside it is 52pt x 28.5pt.

rowArtwork.$description: Artwork in search results and recent searches: 49pt and 48.5pt across the anti-aliased edge.

libraryArtwork.$description: Artwork in Your Library rows: 65pt across the anti-aliased edge.

row.$description: Search result row pitch: artwork tops 281 and 410 px.

libraryRow.$description: Your Library row pitch: artwork tops 465 and 625 px.

settingsRow.$description: Settings row pitch (title and subtitle): the cap tops of the first and third row titles are two rows apart.

miniPlayer.$description: Mini player: 373.5x55.5pt above a 2 pt progress line (61pt with it).

savedIcon.$description: The green saved tick (a filled circle): 21x21pt with its edge.

playButton.$description: Round green play button on an artist page: 47x47pt inside its anti-aliased edge.

navButton.$description: Round glass back and search buttons (44pt x 45pt with the rim).

settingsTile.$description: Settings quick tile height; three share the row (116.5x70.5pt).

track.$description: Slider track thickness (2.5pt across the anti-aliased edge).

tabIndicator.$description: Underline under the selected artist-page tab, as wide as its label (44pt for 'Music').

segmented.$description: Segmented control height (113pt wide for two segments; the selected segment is 54.5x35pt).

shareTarget.$description: Round share target (Search, Create group, contacts, apps).

header.$description: Account avatar at the left of a page header (Home, Search, Your Library).

drawer.$description: Account avatar in the profile drawer, and message avatars.

dot.$description: Unread dot: 7x7.5pt inside its anti-aliased edge.

drawerWidth.$description: The profile drawer covers the screen but for a strip on the right where the page shows.

touchTarget.$description: Nav buttons, rows and the play button are 44 pt or more. Chips (32 pt), pills (31 pt) and the saved tick sit inside larger rows.

hairline.$description: Dividers between sections and under a sheet header: one device pixel at 2x.

outline.$description: The Following pill's outline: two device pixels.

base.$description: Not determinable from pixels. The letterforms are Spotify's own geometric sans, not the iOS system face; Spotify ships its own typeface, which is not public. Use the platform font.

regular.$description: Row titles, subtitles, settings rows, sheet items. Judged by stroke width, not measured.

bold.$description: Page and section titles, nav titles, tile titles, chip-less buttons (Pre-save, Following), the selected tab, browse tiles. Judged by stroke width.

display.$description: The artist's name over the header photo, tightly set. Cap-height readings: 47pt.

pageTitle.$description: Tab page titles beside the account avatar (Search, Your Library). Cap-height readings: 24pt.

sectionTitle.$description: Home and search section titles, 'Recent searches', 'Popular', the drawer's 'Messages'. Cap-height readings: 20pt.

navTitle.$description: Centred title of a pushed page (Settings, Playback). Cap-height readings: 16pt.

body.$description: Row titles, settings rows, drawer rows, the search placeholder, segment labels. Cap-height readings: 16pt, 17pt.

bodyBold.$description: The selected artist-page tab, browse tile titles and the selected segment's label. Cap-height readings: 16pt.

sheetItem.$description: Items in context and sort sheets. Cap-height readings: 15pt.

subtitle.$description: Row subtitles, chip labels, setting descriptions, the promo card eyebrow, the mini player's lines, the notification card. Cap-height readings: 13pt.

label.$description: Shortcut tile titles, pill labels (Pre-save, Following), the promo card title, the plan badge. Cap-height readings: 13pt.

sheetHeader.$description: A sheet's small header ('Sort by'). Cap-height readings: 12pt.

caption.$description: Settings quick tile labels. Cap-height readings: 11pt.

tag.$description: The 'Beta' tag in a sheet item. Cap-height readings: 11pt.

tabLabel.$description: Tab bar labels under the icons. Cap-height readings: 10pt.

notTokenised: iOS 26 glass (chips, the focused search field, Cancel, nav buttons, sheets): blur and refraction come from the system material
Artwork-tinted colour: the mini player, the share sheet and its card take their colour from the current artwork
Continuous (squircle) corners: DTCG has no value for corner smoothing
Shadows: none drawn; separation comes from fills and the glass material
Line heights of titles and one-line labels: only multi-line blocks were measured

page.$description: Every tab page, pushed page and list: Spotify's near-black.

elevated.$description: The profile drawer, and the settings quick tiles (the same value).

scrim.$description: Black at 50%: the sort sheet's backdrop: Your Library reads #121212 undimmed and #090909 under it.

scrimContext.$description: Black at 72%: a context sheet's backdrop: the artist page reads #121212 undimmed and #050505 under it.

scrimStrong.$description: Black at 94%: the share sheet's backdrop: the Your Library header reads #121212 undimmed and #010101 under it.

tile.$description: Home shortcut tiles and the drawer's account card.

panel.$description: Settings quick tiles (Data Saver mode, Offline mode, Private session).

notice.$description: The notification prompt card in the drawer.

glass.$description: Round glass buttons (back, search), centre reading. The material tints with what is behind it. The box's dominant colour covers 56% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

chip.$description: Unselected filter chips (glass). The box's dominant colour covers 62% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

field.$description: The resting search field: white, the one light surface in the app.

fieldFocused.$description: The focused search field and Cancel (glass). The box's dominant colour covers 67% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

sheet.$description: Context sheets (track, artist), glass; reads lighter where artwork shows through.

shareSheet.$description: The share sheet's glass, which takes the shared item's artwork colour (14-share-sheet); 18-share-song-segmented reads green-black. The box's dominant colour covers 38% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

shareTarget.$description: Round share targets that carry an icon (Search, Create group, Copy link).

miniPlayer.$description: The mini player above the tab bar, tinted from the playing track's artwork (this reading is one album's). Not a fixed colour.

sheet.$description: Divider under a sheet's header row. The box's dominant colour covers 68% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

card.$description: Divider inside the drawer's account card.

grabber.$description: Sheet grabber. The box's dominant colour covers 65% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

primary.$description: Titles, row titles, tile titles, settings labels.

secondary.$description: Subtitles, settings descriptions, chevrons, inactive tabs, Cancel. Readings in this role range #B2B2B2, #B3B2B3, #B3B3B3, #B4B4B4, #B8B8B8.

tertiary.$description: A dimmer subtitle ('Tap to start' on the DJ row). Read once.

placeholder.$description: Placeholder and icon on the white resting search field.

placeholderFocused.$description: Placeholder in the focused glass field.

accent.$description: Green text for an active state on a solid surface (Data Saver mode, Always on).

accentOnSheet.$description: Green text and tick for the selected option in a glass sheet (#21B452 for the tick). It reads darker than text.accent; the glass may dim it.

onAccent.$description: Labels and glyphs on Spotify green (the selected chip; the play glyph reads #000000).

onInverse.$description: Labels on white pills (Pre-save, Turn on) and the selected segment.

onBadge.$description: Text on coloured badges (Family; Beta reads #010201).

onMiniPlayer.$description: The mini player's artist line, white at reduced opacity over the artwork tint (the title reads #FFFEFF).

sheetHeader.$description: A glass sheet's small header ('Sort by').

tabActive.$description: Tab bar label of the current tab.

tabInactive.$description: Tab bar labels of the other tabs.

default.$description: Spotify green: the one accent. Selected chips, play, saved, pins, tab underline, slider fill, caret.

dot.$description: Unread dot (Your Updates) and the dot on the account avatar: system blue, the only other accent.

caret.$description: Text caret in the focused search field: Spotify green, the only focus indicator (no ring). The box's dominant colour covers 15% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

selectedBg.$description: Selected chip: Spotify green. On Home a chip tied to a promoted page can take that page's colour instead (04-home-music-chip).

on.$description: Switch on: the iOS system green, not Spotify green.

off.$description: Switch off, track. The box's dominant colour covers 48% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

thumbOff.$description: Switch thumb, off: a shaded light grey. The box's dominant colour covers 25% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

track.$description: Segmented control track (glass over the share sheet; tinted by the artwork).

beta.$description: 'Beta' tag in a sheet item: Spotify green.

success.$description: Saved: the green tick in the mini player and on saved rows. No other success state was seen. The box's dominant colour covers 70% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

notTokenised: Danger and warning colours: no error, warning or destructive state was seen
Artwork-tinted fills: the mini player, the share sheet and its preview card change with the artwork
Home chip tied to a promoted page (Music on 04-home-music-chip) takes that page's colour; one case read by eye, no token

$themes.name: Dark
$themes.$description: Spotify for iOS has one appearance, dark; it does not follow the phone's setting. Read from screenshots/dark/.
